items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: One of them old Mohammed Ali things.

ctx.x: That's the town. And so they had me up there a day ahead of the concert. You know how they do those gimmicks, because they interviewed me on a radio program that day. Said, we got the man here that was with Basie three years ago, been with Lunceford and he's going back to Basie, and he's going to tell you what he thinks about how this battle is going to come out. One of them old Mohammed Ali things.
So they had me on and they asked me --
